title: T3/T4 T04E Turbocharger (.57 A/R Turbine, Oil Cooled, T3 5-Bolt Exit)
description: An ideal choice for entry-level single-turbo builds and budget-friendly upgrades, this T04E T3/T4 unit is sized for smaller engines producing up to 400 horsepower. Featuring a 52.7mm inducer / 76mm exducer compressor wheel in a 0.50 A/R housing, it flows approximately 35–40 lb/min of air, making it a great match for 1.5L to 2.5L 4-cylinder platforms operating up to 19 PSI. The 0.57 A/R turbine housing paired with a standard T3 inlet delivers quick response, wrapping up boost by 2,800 to 3,200 RPM on typical 1.8L to 2.0L setups. It utilizes an oil-cooled floating journal bearing system with dynamic VSR balancing and features a standard T3 4-bolt manifold flange with a 5-bolt exhaust outlet for easy bolt-on downpipe piping.
